prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a damaged shed or outbuilding. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a shed, garage or other outbuilding is damaged by an insured event, we will assess the damage in line with your buildings cover, provided it forms part of the premises insured and is not excluded.
